blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Fresh from its stock market debut, GCash operator Mynt Inc. is turning investors’ attention to its upcoming third-quarter results, which analysts expect will provide a clearer picture of its growth trajectory. Mynt closed its first trading session at its P6.60 offer price. Abacus said the flat finish suggested price stabilization by the offering’s underwriters, although selling pressure appeared limited.
